complexity.notes: The two comparison loops are redundant (multiset_s == multiset_t would suffice), and the bare except is unidiomatic — using collections.Counter or an equality check would be cleaner. Manual counting could use dict.get(i, 0) + 1. Space is technically O(1) given the 26-letter lowercase constraint, but O(n) covers the Unicode follow-up.
complexity.summary: Counts character frequencies of both strings into two dictionaries, then compares the counts key by key, returning False on mismatch or missing keys (caught via bare except).
